question: What rapid inner movement can a practitioner accomplish within a moment?
premises: A practitioner can perform going and coming.
This movement occurs within a single moment.
inference: The practitioner is capable of swift inner circulation in a very short time.
uncertainties: The exact nature of yātāyātaṃ (going and coming) in this context is not fully specified.
plain_english: O goddess, one who performs the going and coming within a moment.
